title: Three Summers and One Short Crate
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：soil　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 soil 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the grower ① tended the soil that no buyer in the greenhouse would have noted, and he said the tending was the whole of the summer. The ② soil, meaning the earth itself and not the crate, ran three summers and stayed unnoted in the book; soil, he said, is the only thing in a greenhouse that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ sort of soil in that greenhouse had the same short crate beside it, and the ④ soil at the far shelf, meaning the bundle they kept for the children to tie and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Soil, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the grower said the noting is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the soil was the whole of the matter, meaning the root and not the earth. The ⑥ soil, meaning the root and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; soil, he said, is either something you tend or the only word that means both earth and a root. He said the root is the part they remember.

By 1984 the ⑦ soil had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short crate. The ⑧ soil of the whole thing, the grower wrote in August, was one greenhouse and three summers of noting; soil, he said, is either the bundle at the far shelf or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ soil I remember is the soil noted in the ledger, which closed in 1986 and is still noted as the quietest in the greenhouse. ⑩ Soil, my mother said in 1988, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all soil, she said, is a root that has agreed to look like earth. She said the root was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 土壤；土地（指大棚里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 土壤；土地（指那片土壤本身，与浅浅的木箱相对）
C. 固定搭配：tend the soil 侍弄这一片土壤
D. n. 土壤；土地（指留给孩子们捆的那一捆）
E. n. 土壤之事（抽象总称，指一处大棚的土壤之事）
F. n. 土壤；土地（指收成账里写到、被记下的那一片）
G. n. 土壤、根基（指一件事里人人都收却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 根基（抽象总称，指人人都收却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: tended the soil that no buyer in the greenhouse would have noted
The soil, meaning the earth itself and not the crate
Every sort of soil in that greenhouse
the soil at the far shelf
the soil was the whole of the matter
the soil had become a line in a ledger
The soil of the whole thing

answers.why: tend the soil 意为“侍弄这一片土壤”，1979 年那位种植户把大棚里没有一位收购人肯记下的一片土壤做了一遍。
soil 意为“土壤；土地”，指那片土壤本身而不是浅浅的木箱，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被记下。
soil 意为“土壤；土地”，指大棚里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一只浅浅的木箱。
soil 意为“土壤；土地”，指最远那层架位的留给孩子们捆的那一捆，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
soil 意为“土壤、根基”，指一件事里人人都收却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这片根基就是那件事的全部。
soil 意为“根基”，指人人都收却无人提起的那样东西而不是那片土壤，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
soil 意为“土壤；土地”，指收成账里写到、被记下的那一片，到 1984 年这一片成了收成账里的一行。
soil 意为“土壤之事”，种植户八月写道，整件事的土壤之事是一处大棚和三个夏天的记下。
soil 意为“土壤；土地”，我记得的是收成账里记下过的那一片，1986 年收完了，至今仍被说成大棚里最安静的一片。
soil 为抽象总称，母亲 1988 年说，土壤是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的土壤。
